units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 9:26">Targ. Gen. IX, 26</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:5">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>קודשא ב׳ הוא</he> the Holiness (Holy One), blessed be He.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:4">Cant. R. to. IV, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32:10">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>הדין טורא בְּרִיכָא</he> this blessed mount (Gerizim, revered by the Samaritans; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:1">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>קדיש</he>).
Targ. Deut. VIII, 10; a. fr.—Esp. to say grace after meal.

<cite ref="Berakhot 46a:2">Ber. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מטי לְבָרוּכֵי וכ׳</he> when it was time to say grace, he said, Will you please, say grace for us. Y. ib. VI, 10ᵇ <he>מהו למיבָרְכָה בסופה</he> what benediction must be said after it? Ib. bot. <he>לא אנא חכים מברכא</he> I do not know how to say grace after it.—Part. pass. <he>מְבָרַךְ</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 49:2">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XLIX, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 2:9">Targ. Job II, 9</cite>.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 56a:6">Snh. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>לישנא דברוכי</he> in the sense of blaspheming.
